skill.name: Spring Boot 3.0 Upgrade Readiness Assessment
skill.description: Systematic pre-migration validation workflow to evaluate a Spring Boot 2.x application's readiness for migration to 3.0. Covers version prerequisites, dependency compatibility, system requirements, and deprecation inventory through a structured five-step assessment process.
skill.skill_body:
Execute a pre-migration validation workflow to identify blockers and scope before upgrading to Spring Boot 3.0. Follow these steps in sequence: (1) Verify current Spring Boot 2.x version and upgrade to latest 2.7.x patch; (2) Audit all dependencies for compatibility with Spring Boot 3.0 and Jakarta EE; (3) Check system requirements (Java version, build tools); (4) Inventory deprecated APIs and breaking changes from Spring Boot 2.x; (5) Document findings in a readiness report. Stop and escalate if critical blockers are found.

## Objective

Prepare and validate preconditions before initiating Spring Boot 3.0 migration
## Applicable Signals

- Active migration project for Spring Boot 3.0
- Stakeholder request for readiness assessment
- Dependency audit or compliance review triggered

## Contraindications

- Application is already on Spring Boot 3.0
- No active migration planned or approved
- Team lacks access to application source code or dependency manifest

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'name': 'Verify and Upgrade to Latest 2.7.x', 'action': 'Check current Spring Boot version; if below 2.7.x, upgrade to latest 2.7.x patch release', 'rationale': 'Latest 2.7.x includes deprecation warnings and compatibility fixes that ease 3.0 transition'}
- {'step': 2, 'name': 'Review Dependencies for 3.0 Compatibility', 'action': 'Audit all direct and transitive dependencies; check for Jakarta EE migration requirements; identify libraries with no 3.0 support', 'rationale': 'Spring Boot 3.0 requires Jakarta EE; javax.* packages are replaced with jakarta.* equivalents'}
- {'step': 3, 'name': 'Review System Requirements', 'action': 'Verify Java version (3.0 requires Java 17+), build tool versions (Maven 3.6.3+, Gradle 7.5+), and other runtime dependencies', 'rationale': 'System requirement mismatches will cause build or runtime failures'}
- {'step': 4, 'name': 'Inventory Deprecations and Breaking Changes', 'action': 'Review Spring Boot 2.x deprecation warnings; cross-reference with Spring Boot 3.0 migration guide for removed APIs, renamed endpoints, and configuration changes', 'rationale': 'Identifies code refactoring scope and configuration migration effort'}
- {'step': 5, 'name': 'Document Readiness Report', 'action': 'Compile findings into a structured report: current version, dependency conflicts, deprecated APIs, system requirement gaps, and risk assessment', 'rationale': 'Provides stakeholders with clear migration scope and enables informed go/no-go decision'}

## Constraints

- Must complete all five assessment steps in sequence
- Requires access to pom.xml, build.gradle, or equivalent dependency manifest
- Requires Java development environment with build tools installed
- Assessment must be documented before proceeding to execution phase

## Cautions

- Do not skip deprecation inventory; breaking changes may require significant refactoring
- System requirement gaps (e.g., Java version) may block migration entirely
- Third-party library incompatibilities may require alternative dependencies

## Output Contract

- Completed readiness report containing: (1) current Spring Boot version and upgrade status; (2) list of incompatible or unsupported dependencies; (3) deprecated APIs and breaking changes inventory; (4) system requirement gaps (if any); (5) risk classification (low/medium/high) and recommended next steps. Report must be signed off before execution phase begins.
